import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    it = iter(sys.stdin.buffer)
    next(it)
    for line in it:
        p = line.rstrip(b"\r\n").split(b",")
        d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    out = []
    for k in sorted(d):
        out.append("%s %.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]))
    print("\n".join(out))
main()

import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b"\n")
    d = defaultdict(float)
    for line in data[1:]:
        if not line: continue
        a, c, v = line.split(b",")[:3]
        d[c] += float(v)
    print("\n".join("%s %.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]) for k in sorted(d)))
main()

import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().replace(b"\r",b"").split(b"\n")
    d = defaultdict(list)
    for line in data[1:]:
        if line:
            p = line.split(b",")
            d[p[1]].append(p[2])
    print("\n".join("%s %.2f" % (k.decode(), sum(map(float,d[k]))) for k in sorted(d)))
main()
